heading: From brief to build
lede: Seven steps, run in order along one straight line from brief to launch.

steps.title: Discover
steps.summary: We talk to your team, read the code, and find the constraint that actually matters.

steps.title: Define
steps.summary: Scope, success measures and a written plan you can hold us to.

steps.title: Design
steps.summary: Type, layout and motion explored as a system rather than a set of pages.

steps.title: Build
steps.summary: Production code in small reviewable pieces, shipping early and often.

steps.title: Test
steps.summary: Real devices, real content, keyboard paths, and the accessibility checks that matter.

steps.title: Launch
steps.summary: Deployment, handover and documentation so your team can carry it.

steps.title: Grow
steps.summary: Measurement, iteration and maintenance once the thing is out in the world.
